U.note: Clean two-color ratio mixer comparing sRGB mean and linear light with keyboard shortcuts and hex validation, but the ASCII swatches are small and the ASCII is a minor part.

V.note: Seeded ASCII field where dragging drops R/G/B or C/M/Y ink that mixes in additive or subtractive models, glyph density and color encode the mix, and the theme flips with the model; it looks alive from the start and works on mobile.

W.note: Painting canvas starts as an empty black rectangle with mismatched white panel space, mixing works but the first impression is blank and the default Paint mode on black is odd.

X.note: Three draggable color sources blended into an ASCII field with Light, Paint and Naive models and a readout, attractive and instantly alive, though the paint mode is a hack and the markers are loosely aligned.

Y.note: Ink mixer with sliders plus a painting canvas that starts empty, the mode switch wipes the canvas, and on a phone the 504px canvas is clipped.

Z.note: Polished two-color mixer rendering the result as a shaded ASCII sphere with a ratio strip and two models, nice keyboard support, but less hands-on mixing and the controls sit below the fold on desktop.
